topic: Credit Card Minimum Amount Due Trap
caption:
Minimum Amount Due pay karke cool mat bano, bank tumhara kaat raha hai! 😅

Banks ko pata hai log impulsive shopping karte hain, isliye woh chhota amount pay karne ka option dete hain taaki heavy interest charge kar sakein.

Smart bano aur hamesha FULL bill pay karo.

Kya tumne kabhi credit card interest trap face kiya hai? Comment mein batao!
